newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to choose telecom sale advisor.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to choose telecom sale advisor.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency said on Wednesday it had received 18 letters of intent for shortlisting of advisors to the government in the partial sale of the state-owned Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC).

The list, made available to Reuters after the deadline on Wednesday, includes Investment Bank Austria, Union Bank of Swizerland and Vienna's Creditanstalt Investment Bank AG together with Sofia's Creditanstalt Bulinvest EOOD.
A consortium of Bankers Trust, Charterhouse Bank, KPMG and Squire Sanders & Dempsey is also bidding. Another consortium is Raiffeisen Investment AG and Lazard Houses.
Consulting groups such as Deloitte & Touche, Salomon Brothers SBC and Merill Lynch International are among the bidders.
Also on the list are also Warburg, Nat West Markets, Schroders, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, BZW, Daiwa Europe Ltd, Societe Generale Finance Developpement, Goldman Sachs International and Freshfields.

A government commission, set up to prepare BTC's sale, is due to discuss the bidders' list soon, state news agency BTA said. The government will shortlist the top six banks. The World Bank, which funds part of the BTC sale procedure, must then approve them, it added.

Earlier this month the Privatisation Agency said the government was seeking to appoint a leading investment bank with significant experience in the privatisation of national telecommunication companies in Europe, as a financial advisor.
Officials have said the Privatisation Agency and the BTC would have separate consultants.
The Bulgarian government has approved the sale of up to 25 percent of BTC.
Deputy Prime Minister Doncho Konakchiev said he expected that the tender for the BTC partial sale would be called at the end of May or at the beginning of June.
The country's concession law might be amended because now it allows telecoms' privatisation only by granting a concession, BTA quoted Konakchiev as saying.
